_comment: Shop registry with compliance results (docs/compliance/source_groups.md, docs/compliance/COMPLIANCE-CHECK-2026-10-17.md, ADR-001). Loaded by `python -m priceintel init-db`. Only active shops are collected, and exactly one active domain per operator_group: mirrors are registered with is_mirror = 1 so they cannot inflate competitor or product counts.

shops.name: Secret (own shop)
shops.compliance_notes: Own prices are recorded through secret_shop, not scraped.

shops.name: Pro-Buket
shops.compliance_notes: robots: Crawl-delay 5; disallows /*?*, /all/, /search/, /c/nedorogie-cvety/, /c/voshititelnye-bukety/. No user agreement published.

shops.name: Uzflora
shops.compliance_notes: robots disallows add-to-cart URLs and admin paths only. Public offer has no clause on automated access.

shops.name: Love Flowers
shops.compliance_notes: robots disallows /*? and admin paths. User agreement: quoting site material requires a link to the site (source URL is stored). Representative of the network (ADR-001).

shops.name: Kamila's
shops.compliance_notes: robots: Allow /. No terms page found. Replaces the network backups (ADR-001).

shops.name: Uzflowers (same operator as Uzflora)
shops.compliance_notes: Not collected: same phone number as uzflora.com; Tilda store prices are not in the page HTML.

shops.name: Dostavka-cvetov365
shops.compliance_notes: Not collected: part of the Love Flowers network (ADR-001).

shops.name: Dostavka-cvetov24
shops.compliance_notes: Not collected: shares 220/224 product slugs with dostavka-cvetov365.uz (ADR-001).

shops.name: Ultra Flowers
shops.compliance_notes: Not collected: part of the Love Flowers network (ADR-001).
